facts.heading: 戒严（基础057）
facts.rule: Non-government characters may still be concealed or directly put into this region. The prohibition distinguishes playing from direct placement.

facts.heading: 空鸣御守（先行牌，百鬼夜行01）
facts.rule: This printed character/attachment is affected by both character and attachment effects, participates in confrontations while attached, can die from lethal damage, cannot move while attached, and is destroyed when its host leaves.
facts.inferenceForBQ026: BQ026 prints the same dual type and its own cannot-move/cannot-be-equipped clauses. Preserve both roles; do not silently change the attached object into a plain attachment. Card-specific implementation/review remains.
